articles.title: FED HOLDS RATES STEADY AS 3 OFFICIALS PUSH FOR HIKE
articles.summary: The FOMC voted 9-3 to hold rates at 3.5%-3.75% despite three officials favoring a hike, citing Middle East energy shocks keeping inflation above the 2% target even as the economy expands. Bitcoin and ether both ticked up about 1% (to roughly $64,250 and $1,915) with little reaction to the decision as analysts said geopolitical risk is limiting crypto's upside even as improving conditions support risk assets medium-term.

articles.title: SENATORS MAY TOUGHEN TRUMP CONCESSION ON CLARITY ACT'S LIMITS
articles.summary: Senators Thom Tillis and Ruben Gallego have reportedly finalized new language on the Clarity Act's ethics provision, which restricts senior officials' crypto ties, though details haven't emerged and it still needs White House and Democratic buy-in. Democrats have argued Trump's earlier accepted version lets him avoid real compliance since DOJ enforcement falls under his own appointees. Senate Majority Leader John Thune said a vote is likely but uncertain given time constraints before the August recess, with remaining sticking points including illicit-finance/DeFi protections and stablecoin reward rules the American Bankers Association wants tightened further. Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong called the bill "one yard line" from passage, though many in the industry are shifting expectations to a September vote.

articles.title: SIP-5: OPT-IN QUANTUM RESISTANCE FOR ALL ACCOUNTS
articles.summary: Sei Network's SIP-5 proposal gives every account an opt-in path to quantum-secure cryptography, triggered if a credible quantum computing threat against ECDSA-based signatures emerges. The proposal leaves current account behavior unchanged while ensuring a defined migration route exists before any threat becomes critical. In parallel, the Sei team is developing new post-quantum signature schemes to reduce the performance overhead that current quantum-resistant algorithms carry.

articles.title: RANGE-OPTIMIZED LP SKILL FOR BANKR AGENT
articles.summary: A bankr agent skill now automates range-optimized LP management on Uniswap pools pairing tokenized equities with stablecoins, targeting the tight price bands where stock/stable pairs like GME/USDG tend to consolidate to capture concentrated liquidity yields. One builder has run a live $1,000 GME/USDG position under full agent management for five days, with the skill available publicly for others to deploy.

articles.title: ROBINHOOD CHAIN DEPOSITS CLIMB BUT VOLUME AND USERS FADE
articles.summary: Robinhood Chain's TVL has climbed to $325 million in under a month, but DEX volume fell 27% week-over-week to $553 million daily and active accounts dropped 7% to roughly 275,000, revealing a split between deposit growth and on-chain activity. The turnover ratio's collapse from 9.25x to 1.68x confirms capital is arriving faster than it is being traded, pointing to yield-seeking behavior rather than organic speculative demand. CEO Vlad Tenev's remark that the chain "works well for memes" sparked a CASHCAT surge of up to 962% during launch week, while the Robinhood Earn program's 7% APY on USDG now appears to be the main deposit driver. Robinhood's Q2 earnings report this week may clarify whether the team orients toward Real World Asset projects or doubles down on the memecoin-driven model that defined its opening weeks.

articles.title: WHY LIQUIDITY ISN'T THE SAME AS BEING ABLE TO SETTLE
articles.summary: An entity can hold ample aggregate liquidity yet still fail to settle an obligation because eligible cash or collateral may sit in the wrong account, custodian, or correspondent bank at the critical moment. Tempo's new report on liquidity mobility demonstrates shared settlement layers with private execution could shrink the cash and collateral buffers institutions must preposition, though faster settlement doesn't automatically reduce funding needs if netting is lost.

articles.title: HPC AND MULTICOIN BACK THE CFTC'S PREDICTION MARKETS FRAMEWORK
articles.summary: Prediction market trading volume topped $50 billion in June, drawing major exchanges and Wall Street firms into a space the CFTC is now formalizing through an advance rulemaking on event contract oversight. Hyperliquid Policy Center and Multicoin Capital filed a joint comment supporting the proposed framework, arguing that Congress in 2010 granted the CFTC sole authority over exchange-traded event contracts, preempting state gambling laws that several states are using to challenge these markets in court. The comment urges the Commission to codify a settlement-based reading of the statutory "involves" test, limiting contract review to what a contract actually pays out on rather than peripheral subject-matter connections, and to publish reasoning when reviews conclude without a block, not only when contracts are denied. Hyperliquid's onchain outcome-based contracts, launched in May and recently reaching all-time high open interest with all positions collateralized and settled onchain, provide the use case HPC cites in arguing that uniform federal rules are the condition for these markets' sustained growth.

articles.title: THAILAND'S FILES COMPLAINT AGAINST BITKUB OVER CONCEALED $47M HACK
articles.summary: Thailand's SEC filed criminal charges against Bitkub and two former directors for concealing a May 2021 cyberattack that stole approximately $47 million in digital assets across 16 tokens. From May to October 2021, daily capital filings showed no material change in assets, hiding the loss in violation of Thailand's Digital Asset Business Decree. Co-founders purchased replacement assets and compensated customers by October 2021. Former director Sakolkorn Sakavee claimed sole responsibility for altering the filings, citing fears of a bank run, and the case has been forwarded to Thailand's Economic Crime Suppression Division for possible public prosecution.

articles.title: VIRTUALS PROTOCOL INTRODUCES POST-GRADUATION TOKEN REWARDS
articles.summary: Hyperboost is a post-graduation incentive mechanic that distributes token rewards into open-market trading for every token that completes its bonding curve.

articles.title: SEC AND CFTC ADVANCE PROJECT CRYPTO AS FALLBACK TO THE CLARITY ACT
articles.summary: US regulators are pushing Project Crypto, a joint SEC-CFTC effort to define crypto assets and clarify rules on staking, stablecoins, custody, fundraising, and onchain trading.

articles.title: ONCHAIN AI IS THE ONE SECTOR STILL ACCRUING VALUE TO RETAIL THIS CYCLE
articles.summary: Stablecoins, tokenized T-bills, tokenized stocks, and payments have all concentrated value with institutions, while onchain AI remains retail-accruing and has moved past the narrative stage with compute revenue at all-time highs.

articles.title: ETHERFI CASH PAID OUT $20M IN CASHBACK ON $676M OF CARD SPEND
articles.summary: EtherFi's card has processed $676.3 million across 8.5 million transactions and 93,758 cards (average purchase $79), paying back 2.95% in USDC cashback with 0% FX fees on EUR/USD and non-custodial fund control.
